usageNotes: Returns the ACME certificate sub-resource directory index for a given PDM node, listing the available ACME-related endpoints under /nodes/{node}/certificates/acme. Use this as a discovery call to confirm which ACME operations are exposed for a node before attempting certificate provisioning or renewal. No special privilege is required — any authenticated user or API token can call it.

examples.summary: List ACME certificate sub-resources for a PDM node named 'pdm-node1'

tips: The response type is null in the schema, meaning the payload shape is not formally described; treat the response as an opaque directory listing of child endpoints.
Use this call before invoking ACME certificate order or renewal operations to confirm the node exposes ACME support.
